lessons.desc:
Explore the incredible regenerative abilities of hydras, and get to know their biology to find out if they're really immortal.
--
In 1740, naturalist Abraham Trembley found something shocking in pondwater. He couldn't tell if it was a plant or an animal, though its way of moving and consuming things seemed animal-like. Raymond Adkins explores the near-immortal biology of the hydra.
